title: Lebanon’s president departs for Washington to meet Trump

snapshot.title: Lebanon’s president departs for Washington to meet Trump
snapshot.description: BEIRUT: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun on Saturday left Beirut for Washington, where he is expected to meet Donald Trump, the Lebanese presidency said, after talks between Lebanon and Israel wrapped up in Italy.
